subject: Re: Action-Angle Networks kickoff - physics surrogates that respect structure
body:
Anders,

Staffing:

- Nikhil Abebe 40%: method owner, repro and the comparison methodology.
- Saoirse Eriksen 25%: JAX environment + CI so the config-driven runs are reproducible on our infra.
- Wanjiru Horvat 25% from April: baseline surrogate implementations.
- Bilal Novak is committed at 60% to this project for May 2026 - he owns the long-horizon rollout benchmark and the conservation-error tooling, both of which land that month. May is our crunch month and I've planned it entirely around his availability, so treat that allocation as load-bearing.

Compute: trivial by portfolio standards - 8 A100s on titan-a100 best effort covers every sweep we've sketched. The cost center here is engineer time on careful evals, not GPUs.

One process note: the June 1 go/no-go should include an energy-conservation acceptance threshold agreed in advance, otherwise we'll argue about it after the fact.

Deshawn
